app_release_notes: v1.7.0 - Plan a seating ladder by CBTO. Knowing your jump means knowing where your lands are -- an OAL gauge, a modified case, and a number that moves as the throat erodes. A CBTO you can measure on a loaded round with a comparator. The New Ladder screen now asks how you measure it and starts on CBTO; jump is still there and works exactly as before. Because the two run in opposite directions, the screen shows the actual seating depth of every rung before you load a round and says which way the bullet moves. Also: picking "Seating depth" on Rifle & Setup now sticks -- it was opening the planner on Powder ladder and resetting when you left the screen; the planner opens with your powder and held charge already filled in, where the powder used to come up blank unless you had opened the workbook in Excel; and every button now shows the pointing finger when you hover it.
